title: City grain (lite)
teaches: pen(k) and ground(m): paper lengths from the nib, real sizes from the scale
burin.terrain hatches open ground and fades out near a named region
isoline-stack crowns sized on the ground; fills.cover gives their footprint
masks stack layers: trees over roads, roads over buildings

title: Napkin sketch (lite)
teaches: grow then shrink (a morphological close) fuses houses into blocks
scallop-waves with fray, filled past the sheet so the fray stays on the shore
compose.hand loosens finished strokes; one seed keeps joins trembling together
linemerge and filter before the hand, so long lines are drawn as one stroke

title: Karl the Fog (lite)
teaches: fills.cover gives a pattern's footprint, from the same run as the fill
a mask from that footprint clears the map under the clouds
areas.move casts a shadow down-sun from the light angle

title: Shaky ground (lite)
teaches: features.geojson reads a live feed: properties become tags, depth becomes geom:z
features.where with side-by-side ranges splits data into bands
areas.around sizes a disc per point; colour, not width, separates the pens
modules.labels with keys names features by a data value
